text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a compact production-onramp checklist to hand to Sales/SEs after the pilot. I sketched the must-haves: SLA language, runbook/support rota, monitoring dashboards, canary policy, pricing guidance + migration notes. Can folks flag gaps?

mike: +1. Can we be concrete on SLA metrics? engineers want targets they can test against.

elaine: Thinking initial tier: 99.9% availability, p99 latency target per model family (e.g., 250ms for small models, 500ms for large), and error-rate budget 0.1% monthly. Open to pushback from infra.

jordan: Those numbers seem reasonable. For monitoring, we'll need: per-route p50/p95/p99, per-token cost breakdown, model-failure-rate, cache hit rate, and canary-trace sampling. Also expose slow-query traces for sampled requests.

ash: For support handoff: define oncall rotation + escalation matrix. Runbook must include play-by-play for: canary rollback, model fallback, token-bleed detection, and customer notification template. I can draft the runbook.

mike: For canary policy draft — propose we start with: 5% traffic for 30m, 20% for 2h, then 100% if stable. Fail triggers: error rate > 1% OR p99 > baseline * 2 OR any security alerts. If a fail trigger, immediate rollback to previous model and alert SEs.

elaine: That aligns with product. We should add automated guardrails: if canary fails, automatic traffic shift to a cheaper fallback model rather than full outage. How feasible? @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Automation update: we can wire automatic fallback to a pinned compatible variant. Need config keys in the rollout spec: `fallback_model`, `error_threshold_pct`, `p99_multiplier`. I can add YAML snippet to the rollout template.

jordan: Good — include a sampled event telemetry payload for postmortem: request_id, model_id, latencies, kv-cache-hits, and prompt-hash. That will speed triage.

ash: Support SLA handoff item: confirm SLA credit process and billing owner. Who owns customer communication for credits? @mike?

mike: We (product ops) own messaging, finance owns actual credits. We'll add the template and who-to-cc in the runbook.

elaine: Docs: public-facing FAQ + internal engineering checklist. Public FAQ should cover expected latencies, pricing deltas for dedicated vs hosted, and migration steps (pinning versions, latency regressions). Internal checklist should be in Confluence and linked from the release.

jordan: Also add a quality gate: prompt-set regressions. We need a small default eval suite that must pass before full rollout. Thresholds: hallucination metrics and avg Rouge-like similarity to baseline.

ash: Operational readiness items: alert burn-in window (48h), post-rollout oncall shadowing for 72h, and weekly cost reports for the first month.

elaine: Great. Next actions: @mike draft SLA blurb + credits flow by EOD Wednesday, @ash start runbook skeleton, @jordan draft telemetry + dashboard list, @deploy-bot add fallback keys to rollout template. I'll combine into a 1-page onramp doc and circulate for signoff.

mike: noted. I'll ping finance for credit owner.

jordan: I'll put a dashboard wireframe in the product board and invite infra to review.

ash: I'll drop a runbook PR later today.

elaine: Thanks — will follow up with owners in 24h. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled task: created branch `onramp/rollout-fallback-keys` and TODO item for infra review.
